Run NMF on a Seurat object

Source: R/compute_nmf.r
compute_nmf.Rd

Wraps rliger consensus or online iNMF with Kotliar stability scoring. Operates on all cells in obj. For multi-group workflows, call this function once per group in an external loop, passing a pre-subsetted object each time.

compute_nmf(
  obj,
  assay_name,
  features = NULL,
  num_top_genes_per_factor = 100,
  batch_var = NULL,
  count_matrix_layer = "counts",
  min_cells = 100,
  gene_pct_threshold = 0.01,
  use_normalized_factor_scores = TRUE,
  default_num_factors = 30,
  nCores = 8,
  normalize_params = list(),
  selectGenes_params = list(),
  scaleNotCenter_params = list(),
  runCINMF_params = list(),
  quantileNorm_params = list(),
  integration_method = c("consensus", "online"),
  stability_n_runs = 10L,
  stability_seed = 1L,
  runOnlineINMF_params = list(),
  verbose = TRUE,
  return_results = TRUE,
  output_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

obj

A Seurat v5 object.

assay_name

Character. Name of the assay to use.

features

NULL (default), a character vector, or a named list of character vectors. Controls which genes are used for NMF, bypassing internal gene filtering when supplied. When a named list is passed, names must match the single group label "all" or be omitted (plain character vector preferred for single-group use).

  • NULL: internal gene filtering via gene_pct_threshold and selectGenes_params is applied.

  • Character vector: this gene set is used directly.

Genes absent from the object are silently dropped. A warning is emitted if fewer than 100 genes remain.

num_top_genes_per_factor

Integer. Number of top genes to record per NMF factor in the Factor_Gene_List output.

batch_var

Character or NULL. Column in obj@meta.data to use as a batch variable for iNMF integration.

count_matrix_layer

Character. Layer in the assay containing raw counts (default "counts").

min_cells

Integer. If the object has fewer cells, an empty result is returned.

gene_pct_threshold

Numeric in [0, 1]. Minimum fraction of cells expressing a gene for it to be retained. Applied even when features is supplied.

use_normalized_factor_scores

Logical. Whether to use quantile- normalised factor scores (default TRUE).

default_num_factors

Integer. Number of NMF factors.

nCores

Integer. Number of cores passed to rliger.

normalize_params, selectGenes_params, scaleNotCenter_params, runCINMF_params, quantileNorm_params, runOnlineINMF_params

Named lists of additional arguments forwarded to the corresponding rliger functions. selectGenes_params is ignored when features is supplied.

integration_method

Character. One of "consensus" or "online" (default).

stability_n_runs

Integer. Number of NMF runs for Kotliar stability scoring.

stability_seed

Integer. RNG seed for stability runs.

verbose

Logical. Whether to emit progress messages (default TRUE).

return_results

Logical. When TRUE (default) the result list is returned. When FALSE, the result is serialized to <output_dir>/all.rds and the file path is returned.

output_dir

Character or NULL. Directory for serialized output when return_results = FALSE. When NULL a temporary directory is used and not cleaned up. Ignored when return_results = TRUE.

Value

When return_results = TRUE: a list with Factor_Gene_List, NMF_Matrix, NMF_Loading, Fit_Error, and Fit_Summary.

When return_results = FALSE: a list with element output_path (character scalar, path to the serialized RDS).

See also

store_nmf_results, load_kstitch_results
